displayPattern: PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic display in Goodman service manual RS6200007 r27 (ASXC, DSXC, GSXC condensing units and ASZC, DSZC, GSZC heat pumps). Digit 3 is blank. Digit 2 is d and digit 1 is 0. The code is d0
meaning: Data not yet on the network. The air conditioner or heat pump fails to operate.
causes: The unit is wired as part of a communicating system and the integrated control module does not contain any shared data
diySteps: Write down d0 before power is turned off
Technician: verify whether the system is communicating or legacy. Populate shared data with the Bluetooth Shared Data Loader BTSDL01 for that model, or wire the system as a legacy system
Technician: the chart says to turn power off before the repair, insert the loader before turning power on, and turn power off again before removing the loader
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. d0 is missing shared data on a communicating system, not a filter code.
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
